layout: longest directed path rank; parent barycenter ordering; no node or edge filtering
interpretation: Degree counts include parallel edges. DAG depth is dependency-chain length, not template nesting depth. Geometry is a layout, not output distance. Reachability does not prove causal influence.
cycle_rank_contract: E - V + C for the one-dimensional underlying undirected multigraph; parallel references count separately. This is not template branch count or evidence of a bug.
